title: Account Maintenance Charges (AMC), Demat Terms & Payment Gateway Fees
content:
Official Terms of Demat Account Opening, Maintenance (AMC), and Payment Gateways.

1. Account Opening Fees:
Opening a trading and demat account on our platform is 100% free (Rs. 0 account opening charges). There are zero documentation, verification, or initial subscription fees for individual retail investors.

2. Annual Maintenance Charges (AMC):
- Basic Services Demat Account (BSDA): Investors whose total holding value across all demat accounts is below Rs. 4,00,000 qualify for BSDA guidelines with Rs. 0 annual maintenance charge.
- Standard Individual Demat Account: For accounts exceeding BSDA thresholds, Annual Maintenance Charge (AMC) is flat Rs. 300 per year + 18% GST (total Rs. 354 per year).
- Debit Cadence: AMC is debited on a quarterly basis at Rs. 75 + 18% GST (Rs. 88.50 per quarter) directly from the trading account ledger balance at the end of each calendar quarter.
- Ledger Inactivity: If an account has zero cash balance, the quarterly AMC is billed to the account ledger and reflected in the quarterly account statement.

3. Fund Transfers & Payment Gateway Fees:
- Unified Payments Interface (UPI): Rs. 0 (Free instant deposit across all supported banks).
- Net Banking: Rs. 9 + 18% GST per transfer across participating retail banks.
- Instant Withdrawal (IMPS): Rs. 0 for standard NEFT/RTGS batch withdrawals; Rs. 5 + GST for instant IMPS credit requests up to Rs. 2,00,000.

4. Physical Statements & Contract Notes:
Digital contract notes and quarterly holding statements delivered via registered email are completely free. Physical copy requests attract a processing and courier fee of Rs. 20 + GST per document.
